manifest.name: gdn-attn-q4k-mlp-early3-mid28-skip0
manifest.description: Retain the measured recurrent and attention Q4_K assignments from PR37, with MLP Q4_K windows at layers 1-3 and 28-31. Restore other MLP layers to native precision to test a faster-prefill tradeoff against PR37. This recipe is unmeasured; its point gain forecast fails adverse stress tests and its task, needle and holdout outcomes are unknown.

execution.packed_wide: NVFP4 if free VRAM at load > payload + 3 GiB, else Q4_K(nvfp4)
